messages:
Jordan P: Hey team — quick heads-up: I'm starting parental leave on 2026-04-14 and planning a phased return (4 days/wk) starting 2026-06-01. Need help coordinating a few things: standing desk/docking setup at home office, lactation fridge access at HQ, and coverage for my on-call weeks (I currently own weeks 23-24). What's the best process to get these sorted? Thanks!

Michelle (People Ops): Congrats Jordan!! :tada: Please fill this short form so we capture your return schedule & accommodation requests: https://hr.internal/reports/return-form (just FYI — people-ops will trigger equipment voucher + access). Also upload a brief on-call handoff doc and list any weeks you want covered. We'll coordinate pay/benefits questions for the phased return after that.

Jordan P: Form submitted and attached a rough return calendar. I'll draft the runbook later today. For hardware: MacBook Pro (13", M1), prefer USB-C docking. Fridge access: ideal to have badge access starting Apr 13 (day before leave). On-call weeks 23 & 24 I'd like to swap if possible — happy to pair shadow before leaving.

Leo K: We can cover — @Sanjay R can you take week 23? I'll take 24 if that works. Jordan, can you push a short runbook (2-3 bullets) into the repo and update the pager rota so swapping is mechanical? Also note Facilities needs the docking model + desk type for procurement.

Sanjay R: I can do week 23. Jordan, would appreciate a quick shadow session Friday if you're available. For dock, USB-C is fine. If you have a monitor preference call it out.

Jordan P: Runbook quick paste:
```
- Before handoff: export recent logs, clear local dev caches
- Run smoke tests: ./scripts/smoke.sh && ./scripts/integrations-check.sh
- Pager escalation: if SLOs trending >50% breach, escalate to Leo K then Eng SRE
- Links: runbook.md, dashboard link, incident templates
```
I've added runbook.md to the repo and updated the rota.

Facilities: Lactation fridge badge added to Jordan P's access group. Standing desk order placed (ETA ~7 business days). We'll request a USB-C dock and power cable — please confirm shipping address.

Michelle (People Ops): I've submitted the equipment voucher and started the phased-return paperwork. Also sent the temporary coverage stipend guidance to Jordan via DM. I'll confirm payroll proration and benefits entitlements by end of week.

oncall-bot: Auto-swap suggested: /oncall swap @JordanP @SanjayR 2026-06-05 — confirm to apply.

Jordan P: I'll run the swap command and do the shadow session Friday 10am PT. Thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
